rationale: Corrected wind speed v_c = ws * (density/1.225)^(1/3). Power-curve: linear-cubic ramp from cut-in (3 m/s) to rated (12 m/s), flat at rated (20 MW), cut-off at 25 m/s. Bias = mean(actual − estimate) over 4 history records = 0.024847 MW. Forecast = clip(estimate + bias, 0, 20). Total = sum(forecast) × 1h step.
